scientific_integrity: Proof uses the exact published cut-polytope facet theorem, edge-switching invariance and convex log-determinant optimization; exact-rational tests are finite corroboration and do not prove the infinite graph statement.
scientific_limitations: Full characterization only for finite simple K5-minor-free graphs with at least one edge, in the standard Euclidean edge coordinates. Arbitrary graphs have a unique log-determinant optimization, not necessarily a closed-form formula. Circumscribed ellipsoids and K5-minor-containing cases are not determined. Priority under alternative naming is not independently certified.
title: Triangle-local John ellipsoids of cut polytopes without a \(K_5\) minor
